evidence_type: 人工合成数学反例；不是GRC失败，不是模型运行，不是现实数据结果
interpretation: A tighter estimated-risk threshold can change the selected item and increase the consumer's future loss. Threshold/risk-score monotonicity is therefore not a theorem about downstream world-model loss.
rejection_rule: Do not claim threshold tightening improves consumer loss without prospective held-out evaluation under the same selection policy.
